notes:
Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics for embedded apps). Team: Eng lead + Search PM + infra ops (GCP). They started on Hosted API to validate semantics and then want Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Key asks: embeddings scale, nightly re-embeds, vector DB compatibility, and cost visibility.

POC summary: used Hosted API for quick prototype (embedding + semantic search). AE demoed streaming and embeddings; SE assisted on ingestion pipeline. Current POC scope: ingest 200k docs, run nightly re-embed batch, test query throughput at 100-200 qps, measure P50/P95 latency, evaluate Pinecone + Milvus connectors.

Quotes / call snippets: "We need P95 < 120ms for our top-queries or we'll keep on-prem fallback." — Search PM.

Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs export to SIEM, SOC2 proof, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for a subset of customers. Retention controls: ability to purge or set TTL on embeddings.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, looking to keep infra under ~$10k/mo initially but willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics clear. Asking for a 12-month committed discount scenario.

Requested deliverables from Redwood: 1) POC perf report (ingest throughput, token costs, embedding latency, query latency at 50/95/99), 2) recommended Dedicated sizing (gpu type, nodes) and pricing bands, 3) integration notes for Pinecone + Milvus and suggested batched ingest patterns, 4) security pack (SAML steps, SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration checklist).
